calibration.scope: Old-match calibration frames 1-40 only, not student test images.

policy: Keep confidence >=0.5; exclude any crop intersecting an uncertain visible/hidden estimate. Max one crop per source frame, fixed stride 3. No API calls.
limitation: Pseudo-labels still have errors and omissions; reviewed samples do not verify every crop. Crops change object scale. Test is 14 full-field images.
